```python
        'url': url,
        'ext': determine_ext(url),

        # files may contain is WebVTT:
        # <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8216#section-3.1>
        sub_info['ext'] = 'vtt'
        sub_info['protocol'] = 'm3u8_native'
    lang = media.get('LANGUAGE') or 'und'
    subtitles.setdefault(lang, []).append(sub_info)
```
